recognize_zh: 成群的異常前骨髓球，胞質布滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，中央細胞可見成束交錯的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），部分細胞核呈腎形或雙葉狀，符合高顆粒型 APL。
features: Cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with dense coarse azurophilic granules
Central cell with bundles of crisscrossing Auer rods (faggot cell); other cells with single rods
Nuclei oval to reniform, some with folded or bilobed contour, partly obscured by granules
Disrupted cells releasing granules into the background
Image slightly out of focus with overlying refractile artifact limiting fine chromatin detail
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules that partly obscure oval to reniform nuclei. Several cells contain Auer rods, including a faggot cell with bundled crisscrossing rods. Numerous smudged cells release granules into the background; focus is suboptimal. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type, and warrant urgent PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) AML shows blasts with a single long slender Auer rod, perinuclear hof and salmon-pink granules with maturing neutrophils, not sheets of hypergranular promyelocytes with rod bundles.
Normal promyelocytes have an eccentric round nucleus with a clear perinuclear Golgi zone, visible nucleoli and no Auer rods.
The microgranular variant has bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules and higher WBC, whereas these cells are densely granular.
